Jason Holder's three-wicket haul followed by James Vince's unbeaten 44 powered Yas Lions to a commanding 8-wicket victory over United Tigers!
After bowling out United Tigers for 88, Yas Lions chased down the target in just 6 overs, with Dasun Shanaka chipping in with an unbeaten 21 off 8 balls.
